state.label: State
state.placeholder: The message, ticket, document or conversation to decide about

help.json: An object is sent as JSON, keys in the order written. A list is read as a conversation and trimmed from the start, so the newest turns survive.

questions.label: Questions
questions.help: A JSON object keyed by question id. Each question has a type, instructions and — for choice and score — criteria.

add.label: Add a question
add.invalidJson: Fix the questions first: adding one would replace text that isn't a valid JSON object.

noul.title: Yes or no
noul.desc: Is a statement true? Answers with a probability.

score.title: Rubric
score.desc: Grade against ordered levels. Answers with the expected level.

choice.title: Multiple choice
choice.desc: Pick one of your labelled options.

checkpoint.label: Checkpoint
checkpoint.help: Automatic picks a checkpoint from the language of the state. Choosing one sends every request to it, whatever the language.

issues.title: Problems to fix
issues.stateJson: The state isn't valid JSON: {{detail}} (line {{line}}, column {{column}}).
issues.stateTooLong: The state is longer than {{max}} characters.
issues.questionsJson: The questions aren't valid JSON: {{detail}} (line {{line}}, column {{column}}).
issues.questionsNotObject: Questions must be a JSON object keyed by question id.
issues.tooManyTotal: At most {{max}} options across all questions.
issues.questionNotObject: “{{id}}”: a question must be an object.
issues.badType: “{{id}}”: type must be choice, score or noul.
issues.labelsOnlyNoul: “{{id}}”: labels only apply to noul questions.
issues.choiceNeedsCriteria: “{{id}}”: a choice needs criteria — an object of options, or a list of labels.
issues.labelNotScalar: “{{id}}”: each label must be text, a number or true/false.
issues.duplicateLabel: “{{id}}”: label {{label}} appears twice (1, 1.0 and true count as the same label).
issues.scoreNeedsLevels: “{{id}}”: a score needs criteria as a list of levels, lowest first.
issues.noulCriteria: “{{id}}”: noul criteria can only describe true and false.
issues.noulLabels: “{{id}}”: labels need different texts for true and false.
issues.badBudget: {{name}} must be a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.

results.empty: Run a request to see the answers here.
results.confidenceHelp: Answer confidence is the probability of the chosen answer — the calibrated number to set a threshold on. Confidence measures how decided the whole distribution is (1 − normalised entropy; for yes/no, the larger probability) and can't be compared across question types.
results.collapsed: Some options were cut to the same tokens to fit the budget, so the model could not tell them apart. Shorten the option texts or use fewer options.

routing.title: Routing
routing.pinned: The request named this checkpoint, so language detection was skipped.

usage.title: Usage and timing
usage.help: Decisions are metered in input tokens. Each question is encoded together with the state, so every extra question over a long state costs that state again.

errors.retryIn: You can try again in {{seconds}} s.
errors.rateLimitNote: The public endpoint allows 10 requests a minute from each address. Try again in a minute.

validation.title: The server rejected the request
validation.help: Fix the problem below and run again.

too_large.title: The request is too large
too_large.help: It goes over one of the server's limits.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests
rate_limited.help: The service is limiting how often this address can ask.

unavailable.title: The service is busy
unavailable.help: The model is busy or restarting.

not_found.title: No decision model is available
not_found.help: The service has no model that can answer this right now.

server.title: The service failed
server.help: Something went wrong on the server. Try again shortly.

network.title: Couldn't reach the service
network.help: Check your connection and try again.

timeout.title: The request timed out
timeout.help: No answer came back in time. Try again shortly.

cancelled.title: Cancelled
cancelled.help: The request was stopped before it finished.

bad_response.title: Unreadable response
bad_response.help: The service answered with something that isn't a decision.
